 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # The colored 4x4 pattern above the blank rectangle is copied into it,
    # replacing zeros; orient it to match the example (mirror left-right).
    bg=next(c for row in grid for c in row if c not in (0,1,2,3)) if False else None
    # locate 4x4 pattern among non-background colors; zeros mark destination
    rr=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if 0 in row]
    r0,r1=min(rr),max(rr)
    cc=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[i][j]==0 for i in rr)]
    c0,c1=min(cc),max(cc)
    # Pattern's 4x4 bounding box is the non-background object nearest top.
    colors={v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,)}
    bg=max(colors, key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    cells=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg and v!=0]
    pr0=min(i for i,j in cells); pr1=max(i for i,j in cells)
    pc0=min(j for i,j in cells); pc1=max(j for i,j in cells)
    pat=[row[pc0:pc1+1] for row in grid[pr0:pr1+1]]
    # Demo's placement is the horizontal reflection of the source pattern.
    pat=[r[::-1] for r in pat]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            g[i][j]=pat[i-r0][j-c0]
    return g
"
